title: 大帽山結霜啦
subject: the January night Hong Kong chased frost up Tai Mo Shan: minibus queues stretching down the street outside Tsuen Wan station, crowds walking the last half of the road wrapped in bedsheets, a stranger pouring hot tea from a flask, and a secondary-school boy at the summit filming ice growing along a fence wire while everyone around him goes quiet
caption: Cantonese-language Jersey club, Newark club-dance style. Rapid Jersey club kick triplets bouncing under every bar, a squeaking bed-spring percussion loop, chopped snare rolls into each chorus, bright staccato synth stabs, and a round sub bass. Crisp, punchy club mix with dry kicks upfront, a bright top end and a tight sub. Female Cantonese lead with a light, playful mid-register voice, half-spoken in the verses and sung in the chorus, a few male voices answering the hook. 140 BPM, F minor. Giddy, bouncy and wide-eyed. No trap hi-hats, no EDM build or drop, no house four-on-the-floor, no UK garage shuffle, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
天文台話今晚 跌到零度
全香港即刻 衝上大帽山
荃灣站門口 小巴排咗三條街
人人揹住張被單 好似去露營

[Pre-Chorus]
司機話上到一半 就要落車自己行
我哋話得 得 行上去都得

[Chorus]
結霜啦 結霜啦 大帽山結霜啦
裹住張被 一步一滑 都要上
凍到鼻哥紅晒 都要望一望
結霜啦 結霜啦 香港都有霜

[Verse]
半山條路 塞滿晒的士私家車
有個阿叔著短褲 拖鞋踩住冰
有個姐姐 揸住暖水壺派熱茶
我借咗佢條頸巾 佢話唔使還

[Pre-Chorus]
越行越凍 一開口就出白煙
大家笑住講 似唔似北海道

[Chorus]
結霜啦 結霜啦 大帽山結霜啦
被單搭頭 成隊人好似一串糉
手指凍到僵晒 都要影
結霜啦 結霜啦 香港都有霜

[Verse]
去到山頂 鐵絲網一條條白晒
有個中學生 部手機貼住條鐵絲
佢影住一粒冰 喺條線上面慢慢生大
成班人圍埋佢 唔敢出聲

[Bridge]
天光嗰陣 佢叫我哋望落山
成個荃灣 喺雲底下著晒燈
佢話今日唔返學 阿Sir會唔會明

[Chorus]
結霜啦 結霜啦 大帽山結霜啦
被單凍到硬晒 摺唔返埋
落山條隊 仲長過上山
結霜啦 結霜啦 我見過香港嘅霜

[Outro]
結霜啦 結霜啦
